description: Instructions for content_operations commands accessed via a contextual tab. Currently scoped to DocInfo commands on the Header/Footer Tools tab. Author and DocTitle insert content controls bound to the corresponding core document property; FileName inserts a FILENAME field (no docproperty binding exists for the file name). DocInfoFilePath is intentionally excluded because its full-path field result is environment-specific and can expose local paths.

DocInfoAuthor.apply: Insert the document's Author into the page header as a content control bound to the Author document property, displaying the current Author value.

DocInfoDocTitle.apply: Insert the document's Title into the page header as a content control bound to the Title document property, displaying the current Title value.

DocInfoFileName.apply: Insert the document's file name into the page header as a FILENAME field, displaying the document's current file name.
